title: Mars Meaning
cycle: Mars typically spends around six to seven weeks in each zodiac sign, but its precise duration may vary due to its periodic retrograde motion. Retrograde periods occur approximately every two years, causing Mars to appear to move backward in the sky from our Earthly perspective. During these times, Mars can spend several months in a single zodiac sign. It is advisable to consult astrological calendars or ephemerides for specic dates and durations of Mars' transits.
